items.title: Robotics data pipelines you can run
items.oneliner: Open SDK for multimodal robotics data pipelines with MCAP support, quality checks, and transforms for video, actions, and timestamps.

items.title: Offline macOS dictation that stays local
items.oneliner: Menu bar dictation app for macOS that transcribes offline, cleans filler words, and types into any active app.

items.title: Turn cameras into bird detectors
items.oneliner: Hands-on guide for running BirdNET-Go locally to identify birds from security camera audio and send species alerts.

items.title: Learn Prela through runnable examples
items.oneliner: Interactive tutorial that builds a toy query language in Python and shows how relational queries shrink beyond SQL.

items.title: Fast file transfer over Ethernet
items.oneliner: Practical Linux walkthrough for direct computer-to-computer transfers over Ethernet at roughly 900 Mbit/s with simple IP setup.

items.title: Project laser drawings onto walls
items.oneliner: Browser-based open source tool that turns a projector, webcam, and laser pointer into a live wall drawing system.

items.title: Deep dive into Cargo scheduling
items.oneliner: Syscall-backed analysis of Cargo's build scheduler that helps Rust engineers reason about parallelism and possible build bottlenecks.

items.title: Reference for ChatGPT work tools
items.oneliner: Browsable reference covering 232 callable tools and 44 skills, useful for designing agent workflows inside ChatGPT.

items.title: Use M4 to simplify configs
items.oneliner: Concrete walkthrough showing how M4 macros reduce repeated Apache config blocks and make route blocking easier to maintain.

items.title: Try a Darwin-inspired open OS
items.oneliner: Pre-alpha open source operating system combining Darwin and FreeBSD ideas, with code and releases available to explore now.
